title: The Simplest AI Side Hustle for Beginners
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Promotional tutorial that recommends Lovable and GoHighLevel and mentions a Lovable link in the description; no compensation is disclosed.

stated_problem.quote: 78% of customers will hire the first company that gives them a quote.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Door Quote Pro
idea.one_liner: A mobile-friendly quote form for garage door repair businesses that gives homeowners a ballpark quote and captures their details, sold as a subscription.
idea.offer: A web app embedded on the business's website that asks about the garage, home and repair needs, then shows a ballpark quote and captures a lead.
idea.revenue_model: Monthly subscription after a free trial; plan prices are not stated.

key_quotes.quote: It'll ask potential customers a few questions about their garage, their home, their needs, and it will provide an instant ballpark quote form while also capturing them as a lead so the owner can retarget them if they don't close.
Remember, this quote builder is going to live on the business owner's website.
Of these two apps, I think I prefer the instant quote generator more or the one I'm about to show you, which we're going to use to acquire customers.

claims.claim: The speaker says 78% of customers hire the first company to give them a quote.
claims.quote: 78% of customers will hire the first company that gives them a quote.

claims.claim: A 24-hour delay in responding can mean a lost customer and lost money.
claims.quote: So, if they take 24 hours to get back to you because they're busy on a job site, they're losing money.

claims.claim: The quote app took about eight minutes to build in the demo.
claims.quote: Okay, that took about 8 minutes and we have a preview here.

claims.claim: The billing setup refers to a 14-day trial before purchase.
claims.quote: What should happen when a customer's 14-day trial ends and they purchase a plan?

acquisition_channels.details: The speaker says the same outreach method used in the video could be used for this app; that method involved texting garage door business owners.

ideas.delivery: Hosted web app embedded on the repair business's website. Homeowners complete the form; the app returns a ballpark quote and captures lead details for the business to follow up.

uk_legal_risk.reason: The proposed outreach method is cold texting business owners' mobile numbers. Marketing texts to individuals and sole traders are banned under PECR; recipient business type would need to be checked.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to homeowner lead data. If UK consumer subscriptions are offered, check applicable DMCC Act subscription, trial and cancellation requirements.

stated_problem.quote: And another problem that business owners have is that they don't know how much money they're making.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Door Profit Pro

idea.offer: A job-level profit calculator to help owners see what they make on each garage door job.
idea.revenue_model: Subscription; plan prices are not stated.

key_quotes.quote: Now I also want to build a job profit tracker for garage door repair businesses on Lovable as well.
Know your profit on every garage door job.
We've got our profit per job calculator and our instant quote generator, both built for the garage door repair guys out there.

claims.claim: The profit tracker took about 12 minutes to build in the demo.
claims.quote: It took about 12 minutes for that.

acquisition_channels.details: The speaker says the same outreach method used in the video could be used for the profit calculator; that method involved texting garage door business owners.

ideas.delivery: Hosted web app for garage door repair businesses to enter job details and track profit per job; the owner uses it online.

uk_legal_risk.reason: The proposed outreach method is cold texting business owners' mobile numbers. Marketing texts to individuals and sole traders are banned under PECR; recipient business type would need to be checked.

stated_problem.quote: and most likely that guy's sitting at home with his phone on silent watching Netflix with his wife and he's losing out on hundreds and thousands of dollars
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: After-hours AI voice answering service
idea.one_liner: A hosted AI phone agent for garage door repair businesses that answers after-hours calls, captures caller details and can forward urgent callers, charging per converted lead or monthly.
idea.customer: Garage door repair businesses that miss after-hours calls
idea.offer: Configure a dedicated or ported phone number with an AI agent that answers inbound calls, collects caller name and address, emails the call summary and can forward urgent callers to the owner.
idea.revenue_model: The speaker pitches $50 per closed lead, and also suggests per-lead pricing or a monthly retainer; no paying customer is shown.

key_quotes.quote: Most of these people will know that they're speaking to an AI, but they'd rather speak to an AI than nobody.
And then you can set up secondary and tertiary people for the AI to forward on the number two.

So, in a perfect world, you use the AI to get their generalized data, name, phone, email, address, and then you patch them through to the owner, especially if the AI can discern that they are highly motivated to get a job done ASAP.
So, when you actually set up this AI voice agent for a business owner, you're going to want him to have his own dedicated phone number or you can port in his existing phone number.
And then every time a call is made, it's going to refer to that prompt and answer accordingly.

acquisition_channels.details: Scrapes garage door businesses from Google Maps, filters for mobile numbers, then sends bulk cold texts using Straight Text. The pitch presents the sender as local and offers payment only for a closed lead.

ideas.delivery: The founder configures a hosted AI agent for each business's dedicated or ported number. The agent answers inbound calls, collects caller details, sends an email summary and can forward urgent callers to the owner or backup contacts. Setup and support are remote.

prices: under a hundred bucks for initial validation

uk_legal_risk.reason: The demonstrated acquisition relies on unsolicited cold marketing texts to scraped mobile numbers for business owners. PECR bans marketing texts to individuals and sole traders; recipient business type would need to be checked.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to caller details, call summaries and recordings; establish appropriate processor terms and retention controls. Check applicable DMCC Act subscription, trial and cancellation requirements if selling subscriptions to UK consumers.
